releaseNotes:
# Hubble 2.1.1

- **Module icons and colours.** Right-click a module in Module Connections, or click its icon beside its name, to pick an icon (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP) and a colour. The colour tints the module's row in Module Connections and in the sidebar. Both are kept on this Mac and don't travel with a workspace.
- **Modules can bring their own icon.** A module can name a sidebar icon in its package (`module-page-icons-v1`, developer kit 1.8.1-dev.6), and Hubble shows it in full colour.
- **Module Connections is simpler.** Add modules from one searchable list, and each module's settings are split into Settings, Updates, Data access and Advanced tabs.
- **Modules own their alerts.** Hubble no longer raises its own alert when a device drops. A module can tell the operator outside HubDash, with its own on/off choices.
- **Zoom HubDash** with Command-Plus, Command-Minus and Command-0.
- Service Settings has a guided alerts setup and a simpler Companion section.
- Fixes: Button Matrix text size applies to every cell of the shown sheet; module pages show live state without a three-second wait; Companion pages open quickly; destination lists typed without spaces keep their names and colour; a removed workspace module whose package is gone is no longer offered.
